lesson_intro.heading: Cloud Operations Associate · PM-3.4
lesson_intro.board_text:
Right-Sizing and Troubleshooting
Finova · finova-dev · ap-south-1

Why before how:
CPU alarms and slow apps often mean wrong size or noisy neighbor — not more YAML.

Mental model:
Right-size = match CPU/mem to real metrics. Troubleshoot: status checks → system → app.

You will: watch → learn → practice one navigation.

whiteboard_intro.board_text:
Right-Sizing and Troubleshooting
• Right-size = match CPU/mem to real metrics. Troubleshoot: status checks → system → app.
• Mistake: Upsizing forever instead of finding the leak.
• Habit: Read metrics before you resize; resize before you rebuild the world.
